annotations.title: Resolve a part number against a datasheet's own legend

description: Resolve a full ordering code against a datasheet your account already extracted with the part_decoder module: the document's own part-number legend and ordering table, as that run read them. Returns the status verbatim, each parsed position with its meaning, page and snippet, any unexplained characters, the ordering-table match and the merged package and temperature facts. The meaning is the document's own legend: fully_decoded is NOT 'orderable' (every character is explained but the code is not in the ordering table), ambiguous lists every reading and picks none, and a family legend can define codes for sibling parts. State a code as the part's identity only when answer.may_assert_identity is true. A run with no part-number grammar is refused (NO_UNIVERSAL_BLOCK), never guessed. No new extraction. Deterministic: runs DatasheetVend's checks in code, calls no model and extracts nothing. Costs no credits. Needs a DatasheetVend API key.

job_id.description: An extraction job in your account that ran the part_decoder module.

part_number.description: The full ordering code to resolve, as printed (for example 'STM32F103C8T6TR').
